# Permit Acquisition
- 1.
 Department heads are cleared to approve permits for Category 3 and below controlled items related to their department.

 1.1
 This should not be done without proper cause.

 - 2.
 The Warden may grant permits for Category 2 and below controlled items. The Head of Security and Captain may grant permits for Category 3 and below controlled items. 

 2.2
 Permits for Category 4 or 5 controlled items may be approved via Central Command decree if requested, but not on their own authority. - 3.
 The approval of permits is a privilege, not a right, and no head of a department is obligated to approve any permit. - 4.
 Permits are invalid if not kept on their owner's person.
